a-country-cobbler

A shoemaker works at his bench in a small farmhouse room, lit by a window. Harriet Backer was one of Norway's greatest painters, famous for the glow of light indoors. She studied in Munich and Paris and later taught many younger artists. The warm light and simple furnishings make an ordinary scene feel special.
christening-in-tanum-church

A family gathers in a small wooden church for a baby's christening, with light falling through the windows. Harriet Backer painted the inside of the old church at Tanum, near Oslo, with a quiet, glowing light on the old wood. It's one of her best-known paintings and a favorite in Norway. It shows how she could make a sacred space feel warm.
landscape-motif-from-the-numme-valley-in-norway

A green valley in the Norwegian mountains, with a river, trees and a farm. Joachim Frich was a Norwegian painter who painted the romantic landscapes of his homeland. He studied in Germany and painted this valley in the 1850s. It's a typical early view of the Norwegian countryside.
a-seascape-the-coast-of-the-island-of-rugen-in-evening-

Waves roll along the coast of the German island of Rügen in the soft light of evening. Johan Christian Dahl, the father of Norwegian landscape painting, painted this early in his career. He painted the sea and the clouds with careful study. It's a peaceful seascape.
quisisana-seen-from-a-terrace-with-the-royal-household

A view of a palace on the Bay of Naples is seen from a terrace, with the royal family's household nearby. Johan Christian Dahl visited Italy in 1820 and painted the sunny coast. The warm light and blue sea were a great change from his northern home. It's a bright, sunlit travel picture.
a-cloud-and-landscape-study-by-moonlight

A study of clouds and a landscape in the pale light of the moon. Johan Christian Dahl was among the first painters to study clouds closely, like scientists. He painted them outdoors in quick studies. It's a lovely early example of looking at the sky.
view-of-pillnitz-castle

A castle near Dresden, Germany, sits on the bank of the Elbe River in the light of dawn. Johan Christian Dahl, a Norwegian who settled in Dresden, painted the castle in a clear, calm style. His friend Caspar David Friedrich lived in the same city. It's a peaceful scene of the Elbe valley.
two-men-before-a-waterfall-at-sunset

Two men stand before a roaring waterfall in the glow of a red sunset. Johan Christian Dahl was famous for waterfalls and mountains, which he painted in a dramatic Romantic way. The tiny figures show the power of nature. It's a classic of Norwegian Romanticism.
dolmen-near-vordingborg-in-winter

A prehistoric stone burial monument stands in a snowy field in Denmark, under a winter sky. Johan Christian Dahl painted these ancient stones, which were fascinating to Romantic artists. The old stones seem to guard a secret. It's a mysterious winter scene.
shipwreck-on-the-coast-of-norway

A ship is wrecked on the rocky coast of Norway in a storm, with waves crashing and people struggling to survive. Johan Christian Dahl painted this dramatic picture in 1832, which was a huge success. He captured the power of the sea and the clouds. It's one of the great Romantic seascapes.
view-of-dresden-by-moonlight

The city of Dresden shines in the silver light of the moon, with its domes and towers by the river. Johan Christian Dahl lived in Dresden for most of his life. He painted the moonlight with great beauty. It's a magical night view of an old city.
frogner-manor

A country house stands in the countryside near Oslo, with trees and a path. Johan Christian Dahl painted Frogner Manor when he visited Norway. The estate is now a park and a museum in the middle of Oslo. It's a picture of a place that has changed a great deal.
copenhagen-harbor-by-moonlight

Ships sail in the harbor of Copenhagen under a glowing moon, with the city behind them. Johan Christian Dahl was a student in Copenhagen before he went to Dresden. The moonlight shimmers on the water. It's a beautiful night harbor scene.
birch-tree-in-a-storm

A slender birch tree bends in the wind in a storm, with swirling clouds behind it. Johan Christian Dahl painted the same birch tree in many versions. The tree stands for strength against the wind. It's a symbol of Norwegian Romanticism.
stugunset-at-filefjell

A mountain farm lies on a high plateau in Norway, with rocks and a stormy sky. Johan Christian Dahl visited Filefjell in his travels. The wild beauty of the mountains made him famous. It's a view of the rugged heart of Norway.
paris-interior

A woman sits in a Paris room, with the soft light from a window. Kitty Kielland was one of the first women to become a leading Norwegian landscape painter, and she lived in Paris for a time. This interior shows her skill with light. It's a quiet room scene.
summer-night

A calm Norwegian summer night, with the sun low in a sky of pink and blue and a quiet lake. Kitty Lange Kielland painted the northern light in the midnight summer, when it never gets fully dark. The picture captures a sense of peace. It's a famous Norwegian landscape.
old-pine-trees

Twisted old pine trees stand in a glowing light, painted with a very quiet and unusual touch. Lars Hertervig was a Norwegian painter who suffered from mental illness and lived a hard, poor life, but he made some of the most beautiful and dreamy landscapes in Norwegian art. His pictures glow with an inner light. He is now admired as one of Norway's greatest painters.
the-blue-kitchen

A kitchen glows with blue walls, a table and sunlight pouring in. Ludvig Karsten was a Norwegian painter who liked strong colors and bold shapes. He lived a free artist's life and painted with a loose, vivid touch. It's a bright, modern look at an ordinary room.
portrait-of-anna-singer-brugh-1878-1962

A woman in a dark dress looks out calmly in a quiet portrait. Martin Borgord was a Norwegian painter who lived in Norway and painted portraits and historical scenes. This portrait was painted in 1920. It's an elegant picture of a woman of the era.
a-japanese-lantern

A woman sits in a room lit by a glowing paper lantern, with soft colors. Oda Krohg, a Norwegian painter and a leading figure in the Kristiania bohemians, painted this in 1886. Japanese objects were very fashionable in the 1880s. It's a lovely and modern picture.
eidsvold-1814

The men who wrote Norway's constitution in 1814 gather in a hall at Eidsvoll, in a big group scene. Oscar Wergeland painted this to commemorate the founding of modern Norway, which Norwegians celebrate every year on May 17. It shows the 112 delegates at work. It's a very important painting for Norwegians.
lighthouse-on-the-norwegian-coast

A lighthouse shines through a night sky on a rough coast, with waves and dark clouds. Peder Balke painted dramatic seascapes of northern Norway in quick, bold strokes. He was little known in his lifetime, but today he is seen as a brilliant artist. It's a moody and powerful picture.
the-tempest

Big waves crash under a sky of dark clouds in a moody, simple seascape. Peder Balke painted the rough seas of the north with a few strong brushstrokes. His art was forgotten for years, then rediscovered. It's a very modern-looking painting for 1862.
the-hirschsprung-family-portrait

A family poses in a warm room, in a group of three adults and children. Peder Severin Krøyer painted this portrait of the Hirschsprung family, who were famous Danish collectors of art. He was a leading painter of the Skagen colony in Denmark, though he was born in Norway. It's an elegant family picture.
adrian-stokes

A thoughtful man looks out of the picture. Krøyer painted the English painter Adrian Stokes, a friend he met in Skagen. The picture is a lively, quick sketch. It shows Krøyer's talent for capturing a person's character.
a-duet
Two people sing or play music together in a quiet and cozy room. Peder Severin Krøyer painted scenes of music and friends in Skagen. The warm lamp light is lovely. It's a charming picture.
from-copenhagen-stock-exchange

A big crowd of businessmen in dark suits crowd the floor of the Copenhagen Stock Exchange. Krøyer painted a huge group picture with dozens of portraits. It's a clever, busy scene of the working world. It's a famous picture of Danish business life.
marie-in-the-garden

A woman in a light dress sits in a sunny garden among the flowers. Krøyer painted his wife Marie in the summer light in Skagen. The bright sunlight and soft pastel colors are happy. It's a loving portrait of his wife.
a-meeting-in-the-royal-danish-academy-of-sciences-and-l

Dozens of serious men in dark suits sit and stand around a large table at a meeting. Krøyer painted this as a huge group portrait for the Royal Danish Academy of Sciences. It shows many leading scientists of the time. It's a record of Denmark's great minds.
hunters-of-skagen

Hunters walk through the dunes of Skagen with their dogs, in the clear light of the north. Krøyer painted the artists and locals of Skagen in the open air. The sandy shore and sky are bright. It's a lively picture of life by the sea.
the-men-of-industry

A group of leading Danish businessmen and engineers meet around a table. Krøyer painted a group portrait of the men of industry in 1903. Each face is a portrait. It's a window into Denmark's industrial age.
midsummer-eve-bonfire-on-skagen-beach

A big bonfire burns on the beach at Skagen on Midsummer Eve, as the people gather around it. Krøyer's friends, the artists of Skagen, are among the crowd. The glowing firelight and blue twilight are magical. It's a famous picture of a Scandinavian tradition.
valkyrie

A woman warrior on a winged horse flies through a stormy sky, as a Valkyrie from Norse myth. Peter Nicolai Arbo was a Norwegian painter who illustrated the sagas and Norse mythology. His dramatic pictures helped give Norway a picture of its Viking past. It's an exciting scene from the old stories.
the-wild-hunt-of-odin

Odin, the chief of the Norse gods, leads a ghostly army of riders across a stormy sky in the Wild Hunt. Peter Nicolai Arbo made several versions of this scene, based on Scandinavian folk tales. The flying horses, warriors and dogs are thrilling. It's the most famous painting of Norse myth.
armour

A knight's armor is painted with great skill, with shining metal in a quiet setting. Ragnhild Keyser was a Norwegian painter, among the first women in Norway to study art abroad. She painted still lifes and landscapes with a clear, calm look. It's a strong, silent still life.
grindelwald-glacier

A great glacier shines in the Swiss Alps, between steep mountains, with tiny people and houses in the valley. Thomas Fearnley, a Norwegian painter, traveled across Europe and painted famous landscapes. He was friends with Johan Christian Dahl and with the English painter Turner. It's a vast Alpine view.
a-storm-in-the-rocky-mountains-mt-rosalie

A huge storm swirls over a mountain peak in Colorado, with a gleam of sunlight on a lake. Albert Bierstadt, a German-born American painter, traveled west in 1863 and painted the Rockies. He named the peak after the wife of a friend. It's a dramatic and thrilling mountain scene.
among-the-sierra-nevada-california

Giant granite peaks and a glowing lake spread out in the high Sierra Nevada, with mist and golden light. Bierstadt painted this to show how large the American West was. Crowds in the East paid to see his paintings. It's a perfect example of the grand scale of Western painting.
mount-hood

A snowy volcano rises above a lake and forest in Oregon, in the glow of late light. Albert Bierstadt painted the Pacific Northwest on his travels. The calm water reflects the mountain. It's a peaceful and majestic view.
indians-in-council-california

Native Americans sit in a council in a meadow in California, with mountains rising behind them. Albert Bierstadt traveled in the American West and painted Indigenous people as part of the landscape. The painting shows a moment of gathering and discussion. It's a record of the West as one artist saw it.
the-last-of-the-buffalo

A wild herd of buffalo is hunted by Native hunters on horseback in a dramatic scene on the plains. Albert Bierstadt painted this in 1888, when the buffalo were nearly gone. It's a sad and powerful reminder of the near extinction of the animal. It hangs in the Smithsonian in Washington.
kindred-spirits

Two men stand on a rocky ledge in the Catskill Mountains, gazing over a gorge with trees in autumn colors. Asher B. Durand painted the artist Thomas Cole and the poet William Cullen Bryant, two friends who loved nature. Cole had died, so the painting is a tribute. It's one of the most famous American landscapes.
american-commissioners-of-the-preliminary-peace-negotia

The American diplomats who made peace with Britain after the Revolution stand together in a room: Benjamin Franklin, John Jay, John Adams and others. Benjamin West began the painting in 1783, but the British commissioner refused to pose, so it was never finished. The empty space on the right shows the missing man. It's a famous unfinished masterpiece.
the-death-of-nelson

Admiral Lord Nelson lies dying on the deck of his ship, HMS Victory, as his men gather around him at the Battle of Trafalgar. Benjamin West, an American painter who lived in London, painted this in 1806 soon after Nelson's death. The scene is full of grief and glory. It's a famous image of a British hero.
george-washington-at-princeton

General George Washington stands tall in front of a cannon after the battle of Princeton, in 1777. Charles Willson Peale, a painter and a soldier himself, painted it from life. Washington stands with confidence. It's one of the most famous portraits of Washington as a leader.
the-avenue-in-the-rain

A rainy New York street is lined with flags, glistening with reflections. Childe Hassam painted a series of 'Flag Paintings' during World War I, when the flags were hung to support the American cause. The rain makes the colors shimmer on the pavement. It's a famous American Impressionist painting.
preparing-for-the-matinee

A woman in a gown sits in a room and prepares to go out, in a calm and elegant room. Edmund Tarbell was a Boston painter who made graceful pictures of women at home. The light and the quiet mood are lovely. It's a charming piece of American Impressionism.
christopher-columbus-before-the-council-of-salamanca

Columbus argues his plan to sail west before a council of scholars and clergy in Spain. Emanuel Leutze, born in Germany and raised in America, painted this in his twenties. Columbus's plan was met with doubt. It's a dramatic moment in a famous story.
westward-the-course-of-empire-takes-its-way

Pioneers in wagons cross the Rocky Mountains, with a view of the setting sun and the promised land of California ahead. Emanuel Leutze painted this huge mural for the U.S. Capitol in 1861–62. The painting celebrates the spirit of westward expansion. It is a classic picture of American history, though it doesn't show the people who already lived there.
niagara

The great Horseshoe Falls thunders over the edge, with mist, rainbow and green water. Frederic Edwin Church painted this in 1857, and when it was shown in New York, crowds were amazed. It made him famous overnight, and even critics in England admired it. It's the most famous painting of Niagara Falls.
twilight-in-the-wilderness

A blazing red and gold sunset glows over a wild lake and forest in Maine. Church painted this in 1860, just before the Civil War, and many people saw it as a symbol of the nation's anxiety. The sky seems to be on fire. It's one of the great American landscapes.
cotopaxi

A volcano erupts in Ecuador, sending smoke and a fiery glow into the sky. Frederic Church traveled to South America to see volcanoes, mountains and jungles for himself. The glowing sky and smoking peak are spectacular. It's a dramatic painting of nature's power.
aurora-borealis

The northern lights shimmer above a ship trapped in Arctic ice, in glowing red and green. Church painted this in 1865, inspired by an Arctic expedition led by his friend Dr. Isaac Hayes. The dramatic sky is full of color. It's an amazing view of the far north.
